thread:
emily_csm: Quick heads-up — Oceana Retail down ~42% tokens (21d vs prior). Primary admin switched to procurement@oceana last week. They mentioned evaluating WaveAI in the same mail. Onboarding POC for new seats still pending. Flagging renewal risk.

alex: Can you paste the raw numbers? Is it seat freeze or lower per-seat activity?

emily_csm: It's lower per-seat usage. I pulled top-levels: active_seats: 120 -> 118 (small), avg_tokens_per_seat: 1,200 -> 700. Overall MAU down 38%. I just created a quick ticket:

deploy-bot: Ticket #CS-5421 created for account: Oceana Retail — owner emily_csm

sam: SQL I ran:

```sql
select date_trunc('day', ts) as d, count(distinct user_id) as mau, sum(tokens) as tokens
from usage.events
where account_id='oceana'
and ts >= now() - interval '42 days'
group by 1
order by 1 desc
```

jordan: Sounds like procurement-led review. Recommend: 1) fast re-onboarding call for new procurement + 2 product champions 2) offer 2-week free seats for the pilot 3) ask for competitor checklist (what feature/perf they're comparing).

marie: I can lead the re-onboard if @alex or @sam can join for demo. I'll draft an email — want the tone consultative, not defensive. Share competitive battle card if we have one.

alex: Battle card: https://internal.redwood.ai/battlecards/waveai — summarize: WaveAI cheaper on batch embeddings, weaker latency on short chat. Offer: 2-week pilot + onboarding session w/solutions engineer.

emily_csm: Thanks. Can we also pull last 6 weeks of failing prompts / error rates? They had a few SLO-ish bugs earlier.

sam: Will run checks and paste failing endpoints. Also sending list of top 10 heavy users to help pick champions.

emily_csm: Ok — plan: marie to draft outreach (target: procurement lead + 2 champions), alex will attach battle card + offer, sam will provide logs/usage snapshot. Schedule re-onboard w/in 72h. If no pickup, escalate to AM/AE for exec intro.

marie: Draft sent to thread for quick edit: "Hi X, saw your team paused activity — we'd love to run a 2-week pilot + a brief onboarding to show wins quickly. Would Wed or Thu work?" Thoughts?

alex: Fine. Add one line: "We'll include a dedicated SE session and success metrics outline." :thumbsup:

jordan: I'll stand by to open escalation if outreach is silent by EOD +3. :eyes:

emily_csm: Thanks team. I'll ping once I have the usage snapshot and send the outreach.
